div.p: This is the overlay network created for NGiNX Proxy Manager. Allowing all member services to be accessed by their service name via internal DNS. It runs on the SWARM.BMS
Think of it like a VLAN

div.p: These nodes all are running an NGiNX Proxy manager on ports 81 (for admin), 80 / 443 for web access to proxy client applications such as Portainer or Crafty, etc. Really, only one copy needs to be running, since the overlay network that it is attached to allows any node in the swarm to answer the call and direct trafic to the node that is really running it.
